about: The cases of the front matter of .claude/kairos.local.md (KAIROS-T-0708). The CLI (index::base::front_matter) and the hooks (session_start.read_frontmatter) read each text to the same values.

cases.name: plain values
cases.text:
---
tenant: acme
repository: payments-api
---

repository: not this

cases.name: one pair of double or single quotes is removed
a comment after a value with no quotes is cut
cases.text:
---
tenant: acme # the tenant
repository: "pay # api"
---

cases.name: indented lines, comment lines and empty values are not keys
cases.text:
---
# tenant: commented
  tenant: indented
repository:
team_board: delivery
---
